highlights: Talk to your agents from WhatsApp: link a number under Marketplace → Apps → WhatsApp.
Start a workflow when someone mentions OpenBot in Slack or in a Telegram group, and send its result back there.
OpenBot is now available in Arabic, with a right-to-left layout.
Turn models off for each provider, and find the newest models first in the model picker.
Owners and admins can see an Audit log of member, role and agent access changes in Server settings.
